purpose: The open high-severity findings the source-support audit reports: citations where the cited source does not support the proposition the finding rests on, or does not resolve at all. The audit recomputes a classification; this queue is where those classifications become work somebody owns. It exists because a finding that lives only inside a 935-row generated artifact is a finding nobody is going to act on. Three of these were surfaced by the 2026-09-19 recomputation; three were already open and are carried here so the set is the audit's, not only the newest rows.

derivedFrom.rule: every audit row with severity 'high' appears here exactly once, and nothing else does
derivedFrom.note: Derived, not authored. verify-rcap-source-support-findings-queue.mjs recomputes the set from the audit and refuses if this file has gained, lost or renamed an entry. An entry may carry disposition and notes the audit does not know about; it may not disagree with the audit about what was found.

notCommerciallyExposed.statement: None of these six routes carries commercial authority, and no route's admission, checkout, sponsorship or credit-consumption state moved when the three newest were found.
notCommerciallyExposed.howItIsKnown: Three were surfaced by recomputing a stale audit against the current compiled profiles, and the 267-route commercial census is byte-identical across that recomputation: no route added, none removed, and zero routes with a changed routeKind, packetFamily, renderer, fulfillment record, sellable, creditConsumable, payment, checkout, sponsorship or credit-consumption state. The other three were already open under the same conditions.
notCommerciallyExposed.consequence: They are real and they are recorded. They do not gate the Mississippi payment and UX release lane, and they must not be resolved by adjusting a legal conclusion inside it.
